query: INSERT INTO catalog.category (code, name, trade_group, enabled, recurring, after_hours_emergency, quote_format, keywords) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, trade_group = EXCLUDED.trade_group, recurring = EXCLUDED.recurring, after_hours_emergency = EXCLUDED.after_hours_emergency, quote_format = EXCLUDED.quote_format, keywords = EXCLUDED.keywords RETURNING id
